name: You Too Good.
summary: "You Too Good." is a Horde quest offered by the Orgrimmar fishing trainer, Lumak, once an angler has surpassed ordinary training. Lumak sends his accomplished pupil to track down his human friend, Nat Pagle, camped along the remote shores of Dustwallow Marsh. It marks the transition from standard instruction to the demanding art of artisan fishing.

sections.title: Lumak's Limits
sections.body: Lumak serves as Orgrimmar's primary fishing trainer down in the Valley of Honor, but even the patient orc recognizes when a student has matched his own understanding of the rod and reel. Rather than pretending to have further wisdom to bestow, Lumak candidly confesses that the angler has become 'too good' for ordinary lessons. To reach the rank of artisan, one must look beyond city walls and racial boundaries.

sections.title: An Unlikely Friendship
sections.body: Despite the simmering friction between the Horde and the Alliance across Kalimdor, fishing often bridges divides where diplomacy fails. Lumak points travelers toward his personal acquaintance, Nat Pagle, insisting emphatically that the human is not to be harmed or eaten. Nat makes his camp on an islet south of Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh, content to ignore politics as long as the fish are biting.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
aliases: where to get you too good
faq.answer: Lumak, the fishing trainer located by the water in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, gives you this quest once your fishing skill is high enough to advance beyond expert.
Nat Pagle is stationed on an islet off the coast of Dustwallow Marsh, south of the human settlement of Theramore Isle.

faq.q: Why does an orc have a human friend?
aliases: why is nat pagle friends with an orc
faq.answer: Anglers throughout Azeroth often share a mutual respect that transcends the faction war. Lumak and Nat Pagle bonded purely over fishing, recognizing each other's passion regardless of the bitter rivalry between orcs and humans.

faq.q: What happens when I speak to Nat Pagle?
faq.answer: Speaking with Nat Pagle introduces you to his demanding artisan trial, requiring you to travel across Azeroth catching rare fish before he will personally instruct you further.

faq.q: Is Theramore safe for Horde to pass through?
aliases: getting to nat pagle as horde
faq.answer: No, Theramore is a strictly Alliance-guarded fortress town. Horde adventurers must detour around the town or skirt the coast to reach Nat's island without drawing the wrath of the Theramore guards.

faq.q: Why can't Lumak train me further himself?
faq.answer: Lumak has taught you all he knows. True mastery of artisan fishing requires insight from Nat Pagle, widely regarded as the most legendary angler in the known world.

angles.text: This quest demonstrates that beneath the faction war, individuals occasionally form cross-faction bonds over harmless craft and common pastimes.
Even within the martial stronghold of Orgrimmar, Lumak proves that patience, good humor, and deep respect for nature can lead an orc to make friends across enemy lines.
